enum Direction { Up = 1, Down, Left = Up * 10 }
enum Label { A = 'a', B = 'b' }
const label = Label.A;
const direction: Direction = Direction.Down;
let moving = Direction.Up;
moving = Direction.Left;
console.log(label.length, Direction.Up.toFixed(2), direction.toFixed(1), Direction[direction], moving, Direction, Label);
const base = 3;
enum Folded { A = base, B, C = `${base}` }
console.log(Folded);
